text:
Maya: Quick ask — can someone pin the model + region health tiles for the onboarding doc? I tried opening the model-health-v2 and svc-overview-east dashboards and got a 403.
Evan: Which account/org are you in? 403 usually RBAC. Are you in the `eu-ops` or `platform-read` group?
Maya: I'm in platform-read per IAM console. I can view other dashboards but those two return 403.
Samir: Those dashboards are in the ops org (orgId=3). platform-read only covers orgId=1. We started moving model tiles to ops to limit edits.
Maya: Ah ok — what's the fastest way to get a shortlink I can paste into the doc and make pinnable?
Evan: If infra is fine with cross-org read, we can create a dashboard shortlink that includes org context. Example shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/model-health-v2?orgId=3
Evan: But if you still 403, you'll need to be added to `ops-read` or we can create a duplicate view in orgId=1.
Leo: @samir can you check whether ops-read includes the new onboarding group `eng-oncall-temp`? That would be a safer grant.
Samir: Checking... not currently. Quick options:
  - add Maya to ops-read (least friction)
  - duplicate the two dashboards into orgId=1 and pin there (safer long term)
  - create a view-only shortlink served through the docs site (proxy)
Maya: For the immediate handover I'd prefer ops-read add if that's okay.
Samir: I'll do a scoped grant for Maya (read-only) and add `eng-oncall-temp` so future oncall can access. Will post when done.
Evan: FYI for the doc: use this render URL for static image: https://grafana.redwood.internal/render/d-solo/abcd1234/model-health-v2?panelId=2&orgId=3&width=1000&height=400
Maya: perfect, thanks — that image URL worked but still 403 when I click dashboard link.
Samir: Ops-bot, grant-read org=3 user=maya reason="oncall handover"
ops-bot: Request received. Applying change...
ops-bot: Done — Maya added to ops-read. Changes may take ~30s to propagate.
Maya: Confirmed — I can open the dashboard now and pin the tiles.
Leo: Can we also add a short note in the onboarding doc about which org the canonical dashboards live in? Saved us a 10min chase.
Maya: Will add: "Canonical model & region health dashboards live in the ops org (orgId=3). If you hit 403, request ops-read access or ask eng-platform to duplicate a view in the platform org."
Evan: For follow-up, Samir can you open a quick ticket to evaluate duplicating a readonly mirror of the model tiles into orgId=1 (low maintenance)? Template:
  - Title: mirror model-health dashboards to platform org (readonly)
  - Impact: faster onboarding, fewer RBAC asks
  - Proposed owner: eng-platform / dashboards
  - ETA: 2 weeks
Samir: Filed: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-3142
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
